docs.text:
Bühler’s essay on the Jainas, their history, their literature and their relation to the Buddhists and the Brahmans, edited with an outline of Jaina mythology (London, 1903). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: On the Indian sect of the Jainas. Translated from the German. Edited with an outline of Jaina mythology · Bühler, Georg, 1837-1898, Burgess, James, 1832-1916 · 1903, 92 scanned pages. Published 1903; Georg Bühler died 1898 and James Burgess 1916; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
